runtime: Existing custom game / vendored Three.js r164
source: Original code-authored object models and room arrangements, based on existing exo-discovery.js / exo-field-clues.js facts

direction.placement: Independent grounded objects; furniture can turn away from its original use, tools and belongings follow specific actions, and some rooms are deliberately cleared. No shared plinths or miniature display-room prefabs.
examples: A meal left on a desk, chair turned out, fallen coat and cup spill nearby
An emptied growing tray, a portable carrier on the floor, a tipped pot and localized soil
A partially emptied rack, trailing straps and cases set aside for transfer
An opened service cabinet, removed cover, grease and tools where someone was working
A lamp and separate battery connected by a slack floor cable after the repair was cleared
A sample trolley with an empty position, a case set aside and wheel scuffs ending at the cart
direction.damage: Unequal interrupted drag marks; loose fasteners and covers below work; mineral streaks near wet systems; bent panels at the known storm site. No invented attack, deaths, survivor arrival or signal identity.
direction.palette: Existing faded sage, ochre canvas, worn linen, painted steel and restrained pale green lights

implementation.planner: dist/exo-room-story-data.js shares object envelopes and spatial arrangements between the main game, worker and renderers. Authored preferred positions use deterministic nearby alternatives when paths or existing equipment occupy the preferred spot.
implementation.collision: Each tall object has a conservative rotated AABB. Floor belongings no higher than 30 world units are render-only. Room-centre routes, node approaches, door centre lines, walls and guard spawns stay clear.
implementation.rendering: Existing room batches and distance culling; actual folded surfaces, rounded luggage, tubular straps and cables, bent covers; original clue animations retained.
implementation.textures: No new downloads; existing Poly Haven CC0 scans from dist/assets/hangar-v1/provenance.json and dist/assets/canyon-v2/canyon-manifest.json.

preserved: original door connectivity, power gates and endings

validation.geometry: 134 object/state/yaw checks: finite geometry, UVs, floor contact and physical envelopes; all 819 rooms have placed moments; distinct moment per room on each deck.
validation.generic_render: All 20 generic sites × 3 decks; budgets retained below 150 total / 65 visible batches and 400000 triangles per deck.
validation.gameplay: Full physical navigation and camera/weapon clearance, 378 evidence routes, 126 actual clue interactions, restored save/XP, HELIOS kit, owned-resource cleanup and controls suites.
validation.browser: Actual production renderers and full-game third-person views using a temporary memory-only review fixture. Fixture is removed before source packaging.
validation.limits: Runtime authored meshes with existing scanned surfaces. No claim of photorealism or device-wide frame-rate guarantees.
